messages:
anya: Starting bring-up for q8b-int4 (today). Planning a focused smoke on our prompt bank before expanding canary. Need quick wins on obvious regressions. :mag:
sam: Cool. Which splits do you want? long-form summaries, instruction tasks, code samples? Also include top 20 live intents.
anya: Exactly that. Also include the small set of known adversarial prompts we use (adversarial-glue-100). Goal: ~1500 reviewed samples.
lee: I'll generate a stratified sample by (intent, length_bucket, modality). Proposed quotas: 600 instruction, 400 longform, 300 code, 200 adversarial/edge. Dedupe first?
anya: Yes. Apply strict exact-token dedupe. Then a fuzzy-pass that groups 95%+ similarity and collapses to representative. Keep a separate file of near-duplicates for manual review.
maria: For labeling create a temporary campaign named q8b-int4-smoke. Note in description: regression-only, do not change ground-truth. Reviewers: senior first-300, remainder rotating.
labeler-ops-bot: @maria created campaign q8b-int4-smoke (1500 tasks) -> group "smoke-reviewers"; tags_required=[severity,regression_type,notes]; ETA 48h.
sam: Can we attach per-sample metadata to correlate signal? Need: sample_id, prompt_hash, intent, length_bucket, model_variant, quant_profile, decode_params, baseline_model.
lee: Yep. CSV header will be:
```
sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode_params,seed,baseline_model
```
I've put an initial batch (700 rows) in s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4/samples/initial_batch.csv
anya: Great. Add a lightweight auto-diff filter: compare token-level overlap and punctuation-normalized BLEU between franklin-fp16 baseline and q8b-int4. Flag candidates where overlap_ratio < 0.65 or BLEU_drop > 0.12. Tag reason in metadata.
sam: Pseudo-checker I'll use:
```
# overlap + bleu prefilter
overlap = tok_overlap(baseline, q8b)
bleu = smooth_bleu(baseline, q8b)
if overlap / baseline_tokens < 0.65 or (baseline_bleu - bleu) > 0.12:
    mark(sample_id, tag="prefilter")
```
lee: I'll integrate into sampling job and output a flagged column.
maria: For labels, define severity: none/minor/major/critical and regression_type: hallucination, omission, formatting, code-safety, other. For code samples also request an "exec_risk" yes/no if code could execute harmful ops.
anya: Good. Also include a small automated check that runs the model outputs through our static code-safety heuristics for code prompts and auto-flags obvious unsafe snippets (exec, os.system, eval).
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign q8b-int4-smoke updated: reviewers=senior(3)/rotating(6); quick_review_mode=true; auto-tags=[prefilter,code_exec_flag].
sam: We should test two quant profiles: q8b-int4-default and q8b-int4-lcd. Include both per-sample so we can compare side-by-side.
lee: Done. CSV includes two rows per prompt_id when both profiles run. Uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4/samples/initial_dual_profile.csv
anya: Once first 300 senior-labeled are done, run eval harness and return a 1-page summary: instruction_acc_delta, hallucination_count_delta, code_exec_flag_count, severity_breakdown. Decision rule: if instruction_acc drops >5% OR critical hallucination >=1 OR code_exec_flag_count increases by >3x -> pause rollout.
maria: I'll schedule senior shifts to cover the first burst. Also will surface any ambiguous cases to the "regression-triage" thread with examples.
sam: We'll log metrics to the canary ticket and push a tiny dashboard (sample_count, flagged_count, severity_histogram). Can you prefix the dashboard with the batch id?
lee: Batch id q8b-2026-03-23-01. Initial job run produced: total=700, deduped=680, flagged_prefilter=92, code_exec_flags=12. CSV in s3 includes flagged_reason column.
anya: Thanks. If the harness shows concentrated regressions in longform or specific intents, we'll run a targeted rerun and try a different quant_profile or fallback to fp16 for those intents.
sam: Also snapshot prompts that caused largest BLEU drops for model-debugging. Include context and baseline output in S3 for repro.
maria: Recording note: do not mark any label as production change; this is for regression triage only. Use tag "regression-signal" on label entries.
anya: Keep updates in this thread please. I'll post decision once harness completes for the first 300. :thumbsup:
